notes: B0 reproduces the current causal-family strategy without dynamic stop synchronization or adds.
B1 changes only dynamic stop synchronization so its effect is not attributed to adding.
B2 enables the frozen protected-winner add policy but keeps conservative unsynchronized base-position risk accounting.
B3 enables the same add policy and synchronizes protected stops so released risk can be reused.

The add policy triggers once per logical trade after at least five sessions, close at or above +1R and 0.5 ATR above the last fill, with the current stop at modeled breakeven or better; add risk is capped at 0.125% of entry equity and add notional at 2% of current equity.
All history has already been observed. This is a structural decomposition and cannot admit a live strategy.
